label: copy-phase input r (echoed letter r, from 2nd recalled token on)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on <DEL>), and mainly when the fed-back input is the letter r (79% of activation mass; ~46-56% of copy-phase r inputs fire). Weaker secondary tokens are g (13% of mass), b and l. Never fires when the r is the first copy-phase input (recall_idx 1 is nearly silent). Strongest activations are r inputs in the middle of the copy (r at original position 3, recall_idx 4 has 72% precision and holds the top examples); r near the very end of the copy (to_go 0) is often silent. Does not depend on correctness, digit count or repetition count. Precision is limited because many mid/late copy r inputs stay below threshold for reasons not captured by position or neighboring tokens.
